decisions.reason: The plug-ins have a dedicated page, cost little to maintain alongside the core GIS business, and their value is still being revealed, so the option is worth keeping open.
The digital twin service is only mentioned on the website and its prospects are highly uncertain, but one year is too early to judge, and keeping it as a low-cost growth option is justified.
Authentication delegation overlaps with the identity service, which raises some consolidation risk, but it is cheap to keep while uncertainty about demand resolves.
An open GIS development framework fits the firm's core GeoIT competence, keeps future platform options open and needs little extra investment, so it should be kept.
The identity service was actively announced as enabling seamless integration of GeoIT applications, which signals commitment and early promise, so the firm continues to invest.
